Animals

Buy animals in the 🛒 Store. Here you can rest, sell and level up their houses.
Resting animals go inside for 3 minutes. After that they can't get sick for 20 minutes.

Sell Animals

Sell an animal you don't need. Adults sell for 70% of their price, babies for 35%, sick animals for half of that. Pregnant animals are sold last.

Animal Houses

Level up a house (up to Level 20) to keep more animals and give it a makeover. From Level 5 the yard also gets bigger. Each house has a most it can ever hold. Press 📐 Bigger pen to make the yard wider (+2 space).

Create your own account to start your own farm. Your farm is saved to your account on this device.

    📲 Move your farm

    Use this code to open your farm in the Farming app or on another phone.

    …
    1. Open the Farming app (or the game on the other phone).

    🌤️ Pick the weather

    The weather stays the way you pick it. Rain and snow send the animals and helpers inside.

    🗺️ Land for sale

    Buy any land you have the level for. Each one adds an 8×8 field. Tap See it to look at where it is. You can move your land later: press and hold it, then drag.

    🔑 Set a username & password

    This farm is saved only in this Claude page. To log in on your phone and show up in the game's player list, give it a username and password on farming-ph.netlify.app:

    2. Tap the green button. The website opens with this farm and your username filled in.
    3. Type your new password twice there and tap Create account.
    4. On your phone, open Farming, tap Log in, and use that username and password.

    🌾 Open my farm and set my password

    🔑 Password for phone login

    Make a new password for this farm. Then on your phone, tap Log in and use your username and this password. Your farm will be the same on both.

    Username:

    ✅ Password saved! On your phone, open Farming, tap Log in, then type username and your new password.

    ☁️ Sync with your other devices

    Type your password once. Then log in on your phone, the app or another computer with the same username and password, and your farm stays the same everywhere.

    ✅ Sync is on! On your other device, tap Log in and use the same username and password. Progress saves every minute, and the newest save wins.

    📲 Enter your transfer code

    On your old phone or browser, open your account (tap your name at the top) and tap Move my farm to the app to get a code.

    📧 Verify your email

    Add an email so you can get your username and set a new password if you forget them.

    🔑 Recover your account

    Type the email you verified in the game. We'll send your username and a code to set a new password.

    📲 Install Farming

    Put Farming on your home screen so it opens like an app.

    1. Open this page in Chrome (not inside Messenger or Facebook).
    2. Tap ⋮ at the top right of Chrome.
    3. Tap Add to Home screen (or Install app), then Install.

    Or download the app file: Farming.apk. If Play Protect warns you, tap More details → Install anyway.

    💰 Buy Coins

    Pick a coin pack. You pay with InstaPay (GCash, Maya or any bank app).

    Scan with any of these apps

    GCashMayaBDOBPIUnionBankMetrobankLandbankSecurity BankRCBCPNBGoTymeSeaBank+ any InstaPay / QR Ph bank

    ⬇️ Save QR to phone

    1. The amount is already in the QR. Scan it with GCash, Maya or any bank app (InstaPay / QR Ph).
    2. Paying from this same phone? Tap Save QR to phone, then in GCash or Maya choose Scan QR → Upload / Gallery and pick the saved picture.
    3. Check that it says RONALD DELUSO BARBOLINO and the right amount, then pay.
    4. Copy the reference number from your receipt and type it below.

    The admin checks your payment, usually within the day. Your coins arrive in your game automatically once approved.
